scope: Theorem 8.4 (Uniform volume comparison and slab decorrelation) of the manuscript “The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model” (preprints/The-canonical-massive-continuum-limit-of-the-two-dimensional-O3-model-October-4-2026/massive-continuum-o3.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e75bfb353c2d3374), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊂ (Q>0)2 be a finite list containing (1, 1) and (1, 25), and put U = A ∪ {(u1/2, u2) : (u1, u2) ∈ A} ∪ {(2u1, u2/2) : (u1, u2) ∈ A}. Choose K0, M0 by Proposition 8.1 for U, with all displayed periods even and at least four. Let ωβN be the periodic infinite-plane state supplied by Section 2. There are constants C, c > 0, independent of N ≥ K0 and k ≥ 0, with the following properties. For (u1, u2) ∈ A, set (n, w) = (u1, u2)2kM0LN . If a bounded local observable F can be placed in a rectangle of time extent at most n/2 and spatial extent at most w/2, then |µβN ;n,w(F) − ωβN (F)| ≤ C ∥F∥∞ e−c2k . (8.11) The same estimate holds for a torus obtained by closing time with any integer spatial translation, provided the support has a lift of time extent at most n/2 and spatial extent at most w/2. For bounded local observables F, G on the plane whose supporting time slabs are separated by d ≥ 0 transfer edges, | CovωβN (F, G)| ≤ ∥F∥∞ ∥G∥∞ e−cd/(M0LN ) . (8.12) The constant in this last estimate may be taken to be c = log 2.
